verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a registered-agent and compliance service with a customer portal, so API parity with the UI is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes. The main host returned a Cloudflare challenge and the legacy host redirects into it, so no content about any API, its coverage, or parity with the UI was retrieved. With no evidence of the capability, the verdict is none, not na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
